source_title: Entertainment Tiger Shroff Firing Case: Bishnoi Gang Aims To Challenge Dawood Ibrahim’s Mumbai Underworld Influence, Say Cops
source_excerpt:
The Lawrence Bishnoi gang is allegedly attempting to establish its dominance in Mumbai by challenging the influence once wielded by Dawood Ibrahim and his D-Company, according to findings emerging from the investigation into the firing at Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff’s car. Mumbai Crime Branch officials suspect the gang wants to revive the atmosphere of fear associated with the city’s underworld in the 1990s.

According to the Mumbai Police investigation, the gang’s alleged aim is to establish complete control over its criminal activities in the city. Police sources believe it is trying to recreate an era when a single phone call from an underworld figure could leave businessmen, builders and film personalities in panic.
A senior Mumbai Police official said the gang was attempting to bring back the kind of terror once associated with the underworld. Investigators suspect that gaining such influence could help the group expand its alleged extortion operations and demand large sums of money from builders and members of the Bollywood industry.
Police believe the gang is seeking to strengthen its position in Mumbai’s criminal network by directly challenging established underworld syndicates.

The Mumbai Crime Branch has arrested 12 people in connection with the firing at Tiger Shroff’s car. During the probe, investigators reportedly recovered several sensitive audio clips that mention alleged underworld figures.
The recordings are undergoing forensic examination as officials work to establish the extent of the gang’s network and identify those allegedly involved in planning and carrying out criminal activities.
Police are also examining whether the firing incident was part of a wider attempt to spread fear and establish the gang’s presence in Mumbai. A crackdown is underway to dismantle the alleged network and prevent further criminal activity.

The gang wants to establish control over criminal activities and expand extortion operations. This strategy aims to demand large sums from builders and Bollywood personalities.
